questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

You __must return back__ the book you borrowed last month.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**must return**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the adverb 'back' is not required or superfluous.
 
• The adverb 'back' means **in return**.
 
• The verb 'return' in the underlined segment means **to give, send, put or take something back**.
 
• Therefore, the adverb 'back' **should be removed** from the underlined segment.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Sentence: *You **must return** the book you borrowed last month*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खण्ड में adverb 'back' का प्रयोग **फालतू है या आवश्यक नहीं है**।
 
• Adverb 'back' का अर्थ है वापसी तौर पर।
 
• रेखांकित खंड में verb 'return' का अर्थ है **कुछ वापस देना, भेजना, रखना या लेना**।
 
• अत: रेखांकित खंड से adverb 'back' का प्रयोग **हटा देना चाहिए**।

 

अतः सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3** है।

**सही वाक्य:** *You must return the book you borrowed last month*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

The new employee asked the manager, "When do I have to report for work?"

options.text: The new manager asked the employee when he would report for work.
The manager told the new employee when to report for work.
The new employee asked the manager when he had to report for work.
The new employee told the manager that when he had to report for work.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The new employee asked the manager when he had to report for work**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed.
 
• The reporting verb ''asked'' remains as it is, the question mark (?) becomes the full stop (.).
 
• The first-person pronoun ''I'' becomes the third-person pronoun ''he''.
 
• The present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (have) + Object' will be changed into the past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (had) + Object'.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• You may think the reporting verb 'told' should be used but the question mark or interrogative sentence indicates the use of the reporting verb 'asked'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 3.
 
• You may also think that the sentence is in present perfect tense because of the use of '**have**' but '**have**' here is acting as the **main verb** and thus, it is in the** simple present tense.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:-
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object)
 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past simple (Subject+V2+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object)
 Past perfect continuous (Subject+had been+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Future simple (Subject+ will/shall+V1+object)
 Present Conditional (Subject+would+V1+object)
 
 

 Future Continuous (Subject +will/shall+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Conditional Continuous (Subject +would+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने या बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas हटा दिए जाते हैं।
 
• Reporting verb ''asked'' जस की तस बनी रहती है और question mark (?) पूर्ण विराम (.) बन जाता है।
 
• The first-person pronoun 'I', third-person pronoun 'he' बन जाता है।
 
• Present simple tense format 'Subject + V1 (have) + Object' को past simple tense format 'Subject + V2 (had) + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।

 
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. This cooled off into the darkness after a few million years.

B. The first time was when the universe began its existence as a glowing fireball.

C. In the modern scientific story, the light was created not once but twice.

D. The second time was when the cold material condensed into dense nuggets and ignited to become the first stars.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CBAD.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'C' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "the creation of the light". Hence, 'C' is the first part.
 
• Sentence B will come after C as it is giving information about the first time creation of the light (when the universe began its existence as a glowing fireball).
 
• Sentence A will come after B as it is giving the reason (this cooled off into the darkness after a few million years) behind the need for the creation of the light for the second time.
 
• The sentence 'D' is the concluding part as it is giving information about the second time creation of the light (when the cold material is condensed into dense nuggets and ignited to become the first stars​).

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *In the modern scientific story, the light was created not once but twice. The first time was when the universe began its existence as a glowing fireball. This cooled off into the darkness after a few million years. The second time was when the cold material condensed into dense nuggets and ignited to become the first stars.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'C' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "प्रकाश के निर्माण" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'C' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य B, C के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह पहली बार प्रकाश के निर्माण के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है (जब ब्रह्मांड ने एक चमकदार आग के गोले के रूप में अपना अस्तित्व शुरू किया)।
 
• वाक्य A, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह दूसरी बार प्रकाश के निर्माण की आवश्यकता के पीछे का कारण बता रहा है (यह कुछ मिलियन वर्षों के बाद अंधेरे में ठंडा हो गया)।
 
• वाक्य 'D' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह दूसरी बार प्रकाश के निर्माण के बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है (जब ठंडी सामग्री घनी डली में संघनित होती है और पहले सितारे बनने के लिए प्रज्वलित होती है)।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Schools will restart physical classes partially and states have ______ their own conditions and procedures to ensure the safety of students.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'devised.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is talking about the preparations made by the schools and states to ensure the safety of students.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'devised'.
 
• The word 'devised' means to plan or invent (a complex procedure, system, or mechanism) by careful thought. 
 
 
• Example:* A workout program was devised to help overweight men and women drop several pounds quickly*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Complete Sentence: *Schools will restart physical classes partially and states have devised their own conditions and procedures to ensure the safety of students*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'Insisted' means **t****o **say firmly that something is true. (किसी बात पर अड़ जाना, अडिग रहना)
 
• 'Accepted' means **t****o **say yes to something or to agree to something. (सहमत होना, ‘हाँ’ करना; स्‍वीकार करना)
 
• 'Adopted' means **t****o **take and use something. (किसी विधि को अपनाना)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य छात्रों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए स्कूलों और राज्यों द्वारा की गई तैयारियों के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'devised' है।
 
• 'Devised' शब्द का अर्थ है कुछ करने का नया तरीक़ा निकालना।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *A workout program was devised to help overweight men and women drop several pounds quickly*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *Schools will restart physical classes partially and states have devised their own conditions and procedures to ensure the safety of students*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in the active or passive voice.**

Fifteen children were rescued from an unregistered home by the police.

options.text: The police have rescued fifteen children from an unregistered home.
The police rescued fifteen children from an unregistered home.
The police were rescued fifteen children from an unregistered home.
Fifteen children rescued the police from an unregistered home.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**The police rescued fifteen children from an unregistered home**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the passive voice and it is in the past simple tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into an active voice, the subject '**Fifteen children**' of the passive voice becomes the object, the object '**the police**' becomes the subject.
 
• The passive format "was + V3 (rescued)" should be converted into the active format "V2 (rescued)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• Active Voice में, एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में, एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य passive voice में है और यह past simple tense में है।
 
• जब हम इस वाक्य को active voice में बदलते हैं, तो passive voice का subject 'Fifteen children', object बन जाता है और object 'the police', subject बन जाता है।
 
• Passive format "was + V3 (rescued)" को active format "V2 (rescued)" में परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• यह past simple tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।

 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'No substitution required'.**

We have finished our work for the day, so __let we go__ home early today.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**let us go**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the use of the pronoun 'we' is incorrect.
 
• The pronoun 'we' is used as **the subject of a verb for talking about the speaker and one or more other people**.
 
• In the **first part of the given sentence**, the **pronoun 'We' is acting as the subject of the verb** but **in the underlined segment it is acting as an object of the verb**.
 
• Therefore, the pronoun 'us' should be used in place **of** the pronoun 'we' in the underlined segment.
 
• The pronoun 'us' is used by a speaker **to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition**.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct Sentence: *We have finished our work for the day, so **let us go home** early today*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• रेखांकित खंड में pronoun 'we' का प्रयोग **गलत है**।
 
• Pronoun 'we' का प्रयोग **क्रिया के विषय के रूप में वक्ता और एक या अधिक अन्य लोगों के बारे में बात करने के लिए किया जाता है**।
 
• दिए गए **वाक्य के पहले भाग में**, **pronoun 'We' क्रिया के विषय के रूप में** कार्य कर रहा है लेकिन **रेखांकित खंड में यह क्रिया की वस्तु के रूप में** कार्य कर रहा है।
 
• अत: रेखांकित खंड में pronoun 'we' के स्थान पर pronoun 'us' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• Pronoun 'us' का प्रयोग एक वक्ता द्वारा **स्वयं को या एक या एक से अधिक अन्य लोगों को क्रिया या पूर्वसर्ग की वस्तु के रूप में संदर्भित करने के लिए किया जाता है**।

 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है।

सही वाक्य: *We have finished our work for the day, so let us go home early today*.

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. This means that decisions should not be taken under any kind of pressure to benefit individuals or only a small section of society.

B. First, there should be transparency in making decisions; secrecy breeds corruption.

C. There are certain values that civil servants need to imbibe in themselves for better administration.

D. Then, all decisions must be taken only in the public interest, to benefit the community at large.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CBDA.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'C' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "the steps that should be followed by civil servants **for better administration**". Hence, 'C' is the first part.
 
• Sentence B will come after C as it is giving information about the first step i.e. **there should be transparency in making decisions as secrecy breeds corruption**.
 
• Sentence D will come after B as it is giving information about the next step i.e. **all decisions must be taken only in the public interest, to benefit the community at large**.
 
• The sentence 'A' is the concluding part as it further explains or elaborates why all decisions must be taken only in the public interest (decisions should not be taken under any kind of pressure to benefit individuals or only a small section of society).

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *There are certain values that civil servants need to imbibe in themselves for better administration. First, there should be transparency in making decisions; secrecy breeds corruption. Then, all decisions must be taken only in the public interest, to benefit the community at large. This means that decisions should not be taken under any kind of pressure to benefit individuals or only a small section of society.*
